decisions.reason: The fifteen-day express program builds on the firm's existing production-planning and delivery know-how, so a large German metal-products firm would more likely refine it than withdraw it after only one year.

The seventy-two-hour express offer is operationally demanding and therefore somewhat riskier, but it still fits closely with the firm's established door and metal-product business and can be improved through learning from early orders.
This fire-resistant steel exterior door is tightly linked to the firm's core technical knowledge, was highlighted on the home page, and already had European approval, making withdrawal unlikely.
An express delivery program specifically for doors and gates uses the firm's existing product and logistics capabilities, and its dedicated web page suggests a meaningful strategic commitment.

The online ordering and digital services platform is less central than the physical products but is strongly complementary to the established business, and a large firm has the absorptive capacity to iterate rather than abandon it quickly.
A fire and smoke protection door sits squarely within the firm's accumulated expertise in regulated steel door systems, so management would usually keep it and improve it instead of dropping it.
